Public Function Probe(ByVal path As String, ByVal which As Long, ByVal reopen As Boolean) As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, h As Object, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Hyperlinks.Add ws.Range("D5"), "http://example.com/a"
    ws.Hyperlinks.Add ws.Range("D6"), "http://example.com/b"
    If reopen Then
        wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set h = ws.Range("Q2").Hyperlinks
    Case 1
        Set h = ws.Range("Q:Q").Hyperlinks
    Case 2
        Set h = ws.Range("D5:D6").Hyperlinks: ws.Hyperlinks.Delete
    Case 3
        Set h = ws.Range("D5:D6").Hyperlinks: ws.Range("D5").Hyperlinks.Delete
    Case 4
        ws.Range("D5:D6").Hyperlinks.Delete: Set h = ws.Range("D5:D6").Hyperlinks
    Case 5
        Set h = ws.Range("D5").Hyperlinks: ws.Columns(1).Insert
    Case 6
        ws.Columns(1).Insert: Set h = ws.Range("D5").Hyperlinks
    End Select
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = "before E" & Err.Number & "|": Err.Clear
    s = s & "count " & h.Count
    h.Delete
    s = s & "|delete E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|left " & ws.Hyperlinks.Count
    wb.Close False
    Probe = s
End Function
